kids.text: OpenThrone runs on a persistent cycle. Every 30 minutes you earn attack turns. Spend turns to raid other players for gold and experience. Use gold to grow your army and fortify your kingdom. Rise through the ranks until your name is whispered across the realm.
Attack turns regenerate every 30 minutes, even while offline.
Spend turns to raid other commanders. Steal gold and earn experience.
Invest gold in soldiers, weapons, armor, and fortifications.
Climb the leaderboards. Form alliances. Control the realm.
Four distinct races, each with unique strengths. Your choice shapes your strategy from day one.
+5% defense bonus. Elven spies gain a 5% strength multiplier; sentries also gain 5% strength and a further 4% multiplier.
+5% offense bonus, with an additional 2% multiplier to offensive, defensive, and spy strength. A flexible choice for mixed armies.
+5% defense bonus and a 3% pillage bonus before loot caps. Build a guarded kingdom and profit from successful raids.
+5% offense bonus. Spy operations use a 5% lower stamina-cost multiplier, rounded up per operation.

Race bonuses shape your army; no race automatically defeats another. Melee attacks meet melee defense, and ranged attacks meet ranged defense. Scout the enemy and equip troops for the pressure you expect.
Citizens arrive daily. Decide how to train each one — your army composition defines your strategy.
Generate gold passively. The backbone of your economy.
Your offensive force. Equip with weapons to maximize plunder.
Protect your kingdom from raids. Equip with armor to survive sieges.
Scout enemy defenses before attacking. Sabotage from the shadows.
Gold is the lifeblood of your empire. Manage it wisely — what you don't protect, someone will take.
Safely store gold away from raiders. Upgrade for higher capacity.
Purchase weapons and armor for your troops. Upgrade to unlock better equipment.
Strengthen your defenses. Higher walls mean fewer casualties when attacked.
Increase passive gold generation. Essential for long-term growth.
Victory isn't just about numbers. Scout your targets, exploit weaknesses, and time your strikes.
Choose a target, commit attack turns, and plunder gold. Stronger armies deal more damage.
When attacked, your defense soldiers and fortifications determine your losses.
Send spies to scout enemy troop counts before committing to an attack.
No commander rules alone. Join or create an alliance for mutual protection, coordinated attacks, and shared glory.
